serena (docs): Hey team — opening a quick thread to coordinate the quota simulation snippet for the rate/usage docs. I pushed a draft in the PR: https://rwd/pulls/4821. Need a) correctness check for the meter headers, b) a simple traffic simulation snippet we can include, and c) final dashboard panel link.

tyler (eng): Looking now. Quick note: the draft uses X-Rate-Limit-Remaining which we don't return on meter v2. Should be X-Quota-Remaining or use the /quota endpoint for programmatic checks.

serena (docs): Good catch. I'll swap the header examples. ramiro, can we keep the simulation focused on burst + steady-state examples? product wants an example showing a PLG app spiking at onboarding.

ramiro (product): Yep, onboarding spike + day-to-day baseline. Also include guidance on how to map burst credits to tier thresholds (basic/pro). One-liner explanation is fine.

lisa (analytics): For the dashboard link, use the new panel id 98234 (consumption by tier). I'll paste the export link in a sec. Also the simulation snippet should show token vs request count distinction — many customers confuse them.

serena (docs): Draft snippet I'm proposing (in PR) — short Python simulation using our SDK:

```
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="${{REDWOOD_KEY}}")

# simulate 2s onboarding spike then steady traffic
for t in range(0, 300):
    if t < 20:
        r = client.generate(model="rw-large", prompt="onboard", max_tokens=300)
    else:
        r = client.generate(model="rw-medium", prompt="daily", max_tokens=60)
    print(t, r.request_id, r.quota_remaining)
```

This prints per-request quota_remaining — replace with /quota call if you want aggregate.

tyler (eng): Small nit: SDK response property is now quota_left (snake_case) and request_id is id. Also, avoid suggesting printing secrets — okay otherwise. I'll update my comment on the PR.

serena (docs): Thanks — I'll change the snippet to use quota_left and id. ramiro, for the burst credits mapping would you prefer a table or a short paragraph?

ramiro (product): Short paragraph + one small table is ideal. Table: Tier | Monthly quota | Burst credits. Keep numbers illustrative, not contractual.

lisa (analytics): Dashboard link: https://grafana/redwood/d/consumption/consumption-by-tier?panelId=98234 — include a note that panel IDs may change between clusters and to prefer permalink if embedding.

ci-bot: Automated check — docs PR 4821: link-check failed (https://grafana/redwood/... returned 403). Please confirm the panel is accessible to public docs or use a screenshot.

serena (docs): Good point. Let's fallback: include a screenshot artifact and a permalink with a note about internal access. Tyler, can you generate the screenshot and upload to the PR artifacts?

tyler (eng): Yep, will attach a compressed PNG to the PR by EOD.

lisa (analytics): Also GC: add a short note under "Metering v2" that explains the difference between per-request and per-token accounting — that will reduce support tickets.

serena (docs): Added to checklist in PR. Final ask: can folks react with :+1: when you've reviewed the updated snippet in the PR? I'll merge after CI passes and the image is attached.

tyler (eng): +1 — will update snippet.

ramiro (product): +1

lisa (analytics): +1

ci-bot: CI update — link-check now pending.

serena (docs): Thanks everyone — closing thread once merged.
